name: cleanroom_r2e_top2000_bounded_residual_v2
motivation: V1 residual heads reduce pairwise training loss but residual L2 grows to roughly 10 and overwhelms the frozen cosine ranking. Test whether the learned pair signal is useful under a bounded post-hoc residual scale without retraining or reading any outer benchmark.
training: reuse the already-trained V1 fold-specific PairResidualHead unchanged; no new fitting
evaluation: full 185918-protein candidate universe; only frozen coarse Top-2000 may change order

selection_rule.eligibility: candidate scale must have non-negative mean delta across the three folds for every primary metric and strictly positive mean delta for at least four of six primary metrics
selection_rule.robustness_guard: MRR, MAP and Hit@10 may not regress by more than 2 percent relative to scale=0 on any individual fold
selection_rule.tie_break: among eligible nonzero scales, maximize mean fold-wise percentile across the six primary metrics; then maximize worst-fold percentile; then choose the smaller residual scale
selection_rule.fallback: if no nonzero scale is eligible, reject the pair residual expert and retain frozen coarse

outer_policy: No outer reranker evaluation is allowed until this exact protocol has completed and a nonzero scale passes the internal promotion rule. Outer results may not alter the scale grid or selection rule.
